answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can issue one identity credential per verified hardware enclave: each agent proves itself inside a TEE at dawn of its onboarding, binding its keypair to a unique attested enclave. Spinning up fake identities then requires buying real chips, not free processes. Like the tide wearing down sand castles, hardware cost erodes cheap fraud; like a gale scattering paper kites, fakes collapse when audits demand fresh attestation quotes. Any identity failing re-attestation is burned and its stake slashed, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
